summary: Backup repository registration records real health immediately; task history shows the executing host for backup requests relayed through the pool master.

guide.reason: Operator steps are unchanged; a new repository shows online (or offline) at once instead of unknown, and the Task history host column names the executing host.

api.reason: GET /api/v1/operations returns the executing host_id for backup-* kinds; no schema, request or Core command changes.

roadmap.reason: Bug fixes; no milestone or acceptance gate changes.

state.reason: Health is written to the existing Core repository record; the Controller only changes which stored host it displays and keeps no new data.

verification.method: Focused Go tests for the agent and controller packages; no real S3 endpoint or multi-host lab was run.
